reason: The quote states exactly that all account holders can create cross-Region reports and management and delegated administrator account holders can also create cross-account reports.
The first quote gives frameworks with one or more governance control templates; the second gives the automatic report every 24 hours to Amazon S3 and on-demand reports.
The quotes give two report types chosen at creation, the jobs report, and the compliance report that monitors resource levels or controls in effect.

The three document history rows give the August 7, 2024 secondary vault entry with RAM sharing, the June 27, 2024 preview closure, and the November 17, 2025 primary backup entry with the previous copy-only behavior.
The quote names EBS Snapshots Archive as EBS cold storage and states the transition with both conditions: cold storage enabled and backup frequency monthly or less often.
The intro sentence and each of the seven quoted table rows give the full list; the Aurora DSQL row has a check in the seventh column, Lifecycle to cold storage, of the quoted header.
The first quote carries the condition (copy specified and supported for the resource type) and the snapshot-then-copy behavior; the second states no on-demand copies of continuous backups.
The quote states RDS continuous backups cannot be copied because transaction logs cannot be copied, and that AWS Backup instead creates and copies a snapshot at the backup plan frequency.
The footnote quote states Multi-AZ instances can be copied but Multi-AZ clusters support no copy operations; the RDS page quote states copying a Multi-AZ DB cluster snapshot is not supported.
The quotes state advanced DynamoDB features are enabled by default for customers onboarding after November 2021 and the recommendation that all existing customers enable them.
The quotes state periodic snapshot-based backups that do not replace or duplicate native PITR (continuous), the option to enable both when the strategy needs both, and charges for both.

The three quotes carry each clause: lifecycle or tag changes after creation, what the lifecycle defines, automatic transition and expiry, the ignored cold expression for other resources, and the console tag-edit limit to EFS and advanced DynamoDB.
The quote states every backup is created and stored in warm storage, the optional transition to lower-cost cold storage, and that the feature availability table shows which resources have it.

The first quote begins 'These are recovery points...'; that 'these' means EXPIRED recovery points is stated only in the preceding unquoted sentence 'You have EXPIRED recovery points', so the claim's subject is not carried by the quote.
The FAQ quote states verbatim that the lifecycle feature can automatically transition recovery points from warm to a lower-cost cold storage tier.

The quote states copies can be created from the owning account and shared accounts can view or restore but not create a copy.

The two quotes give the 'even when incremental scanning is selected' scope and the expired-baseline rule of more than 365 days with the GuardDuty 365-day retention reason.

The quotes state selection by resource types or tags but not individual ARNs, and use of a local backup plan resource assignment for individual ARNs.
The quote states the backup plan requirement, minimum 1 day, maximum 35 days and that the change takes effect when the next backup completes.
